decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because the duplicate charge has already been refunded. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-31, 84 days after the disputed transaction posted on 2026-08-08. That is inside the 120-day time limit. The ledger shows one authorisation, AUTH-008204 (60.60 EUR, approved on 2026-08-07), posted twice at RIVERSIDE OUTFITTERS: TXN-008005 (60.60 EUR, 2026-08-07 12:32) and TXN-008006 (60.60 EUR, 2026-08-07 12:34), both posted on 2026-08-08. So the cardholder was charged twice. However, the merchant posted refund TXN-008007 for 60.60 EUR on 2026-08-14, and it is linked to the disputed posting TXN-008006. The duplicate-already-refunded rule says that when the merchant has already refunded the duplicate posting, nothing remains in dispute and the dispute is declined.
